note: Generated structural input schemas. Runtime refinements, signatures, ownership, availability, money ceilings, URL policy and durable state remain authoritative. A listed tool is not proof its facade is installed. This catalog format is not a wire protocol negotiation version.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Read balances for the signed request identity.

tools.name: top_up
tools.description: Start or submit a separate CEP-8 funding operation.

tools.name: funded_admission
tools.description: Reserve capacity and a sat-denominated cap before work.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Generate an applet after admission, or save a development pending action.

tools.name: revise_session
tools.description: Create a metered revision of an owned session at the expected version.

tools.name: resume_session
tools.description: Explicitly approve continuation of one exact pending action.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Read owner-scoped session state and billing, or a pending action.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Read a verified artifact descriptor or its capability review.

tools.name: publication
tools.description: Coordinate owner-signed publication when the promoted facade is installed.

tools.name: service_info
tools.description: Read development mode, availability, required ceilings and caller-scoped historical estimates.

tools.name: development_faucet
tools.description: Mint local test Cashu; never real money.

tools.name: projects
tools.description: List, read or rename projects belonging to the signed request identity.

tools.name: remix_import
tools.description: Validate a signed applet and import isolated source or staged HTML.

tools.name: development_publication
tools.description: Suggest metadata, prepare, replace unfinished drafts, submit and explicitly republish user-signed development publications.

tools.name: operation_diagnostic
tools.description: Read bounded diagnostics for an owned model operation.

tools.name: cvm_admin
tools.description: Private operator configuration and job inspection; operator key required.
